what_happened: On an open highway with nothing close ahead (lead gap over 43 m), the ego braked hard from 24 to 7 m/s for no reason and drifted left over the lane line. Its front clipped actor 1, which had been behind it in the left lane and was now alongside after the ego slowed.

On a multi-lane highway in the rain, the ego slowed from 6.7 to 4.6 m/s and drifted left, ending up 1.7 m off the recorded path, even though the route command had changed to RIGHT. Actor 41 passed it in the left lane, and the ego's front hit 41's right rear as the ego crossed into that lane.

On a multi-lane highway with a STRAIGHT command, the policy's plan (orange) kept bending left, away from the route (green). At about 5 m/s the ego drifted into the left lane and its front hit actor 41, which was driving alongside in that lane. There was no lead-vehicle conflict: the gap ahead was about 20 m.

After handoff, the ego slowed from about 6.6 to 4.6 m/s and drifted left toward the adjacent lane, roughly following the human's left lane-change path, while actor 41 came up from behind-left in that lane. At 7.2 s the ego's front-left corner clipped 41 as it drew level, about 1.3 m off the recorded path. The ego was slower than the human, which probably let 41 reach its side.

On an open multi-lane highway with no lead within about 45 m, the ego braked hard for no visible reason, from 22 to 6 m/s. At the same time its planned path drifted left toward the left lane line. Vehicle 1 was overtaking in the left lane, and the ego's front-left clipped it as it went by (front collision at 8.1 s). The hard braking likely also explains the later rear contact.

On a clear multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle within about 43 m, the ego braked hard for no visible reason, slowing from 23.7 to 7.5 m/s and falling well behind its recorded position. At the same time it drifted left toward the lane line and side-swiped actor 1, which was coming up in the adjacent left lane.

On an open highway with no lead vehicle within about 43 m, the ego braked hard for no visible reason, slowing from 23.7 to 7.1 m/s, while drifting about 1.2 m left of the recorded path. Actor 1 had been behind in the left lane and drew alongside because the ego slowed, and the ego's front-left corner hit it across the lane line.

The route command was RIGHT and the recorded path bore right, but the ego drifted left toward the line into the next lane while slowing from 6.7 to 4.6 m/s. Its front-left corner hit actor 41, which was passing it on the left in that lane.
